# dsh-session-curator
**English** | 中文
A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that adds **session deletion** and **archive management**.
DSH can archive and pin a session but offers no API to delete one. This plugin does the file-level w
ork itself, and deletion is **permanent**: the session directory and its projection cache are remove
d from disk. If you want to be able to bring a session back later, **archive it instead** — archivin
g also hides it from the sidebar and is fully reversible.
## Features
| Where | What |
| Session row `⋯` menu | **Delete session** — permanently removes it from disk after a confirmation

|
| Settings → **Session manager** | Two tabs — **archived / pinned** — grouped by the session's ori

ginal workspace folder, with per-row and bulk actions |
| Settings → **Session manager** → **Setting
s** | Basics (default tab, grouping, **sidebar archived visibility**, row details, order), the insta

lled version, and an upgrade hint with the exact command when npm has a newer release |
| Confirmati
on dialog | Permanent deletion; it warns that this cannot be undone and hints to use **Archive** ins

tead, and needs an explicit "I cannot undo this" tick |
| Disk usage tab | Read-only totals plus lar
gest / least-recently-opened sessions, each archivable in place |
Deletion is permanent and never touches a running session (or the session currently in use). Anythin
g you want to keep should be archived instead.

The command runs pnpm inside that profile and records the package in both `dependencies` and `dsh.pr
ofile.bundles`. Restart DSH to pick up the host half; the client half only needs a page refresh.
The published package is dependency-free and needs no build: `lib/` is plain ESM JavaScript(`lib/ind
ex.js` for the host half, `lib/client.js` for the client bundle). Sources live in `src/` as TypeScri
pt; contributors run `pnpm install` once and `pnpm run build` (tsc for the host half, esbuild for th
e client bundle) to regenerate `lib/`.
